_comment: This repo's own CLAUDE.md sections (outside the shared block), each classified for the shared checks' rules-gated (tools/checks, its gates.json holds the vocabulary and the shared block's rows). Paths are from the workspace top. Held by `checks one rules-gated .` from the workspace.

rules.rule: the hand-synced copies, the same list every one of them carries
rules.note: the list is compared both ways with the top level's by tests/test_sync_list.py, which ./dev.sh test runs (skipped, saying so, in a lone clone)

rules.rule: a block edited in place is reported as drift
rules.note: setup reports an edited block as drift and never overwrites it (test_locally_edited_block_is_drift_and_untouched, mutant rules-overwrite-edit); ./dev.sh self runs it on this repo
